description: This Java class defines a data structure (StreamTrigger) for specifying timestamps and scheduling information used to trigger and manage streaming processes in an Akka-based system. It includes methods for creation, rescheduling, and calculation of stream triggers based on timing parameters.

classes.name: StreamTrigger
classes.description: A final class encapsulating timestamps and scheduling details for streaming triggers, including factory methods, rescheduling, and calculation logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new StreamTrigger with specified query start/end and planned stream start times.

methods.name: getPlannedStreamStart
methods.description: Returns the timestamp planned for the start of the stream.

methods.name: getQueryEnd
methods.description: Returns the maximum creation time of entities to be queried.

methods.name: getQueryStart
methods.description: Returns the minimum creation time of entities to be queried.

methods.name: rescheduleAt
methods.description: Returns a new StreamTrigger instance rescheduled at a new planned stream start time.

methods.name: calculateStreamTrigger
methods.description: Calculates and returns a StreamTrigger based on current time, query start, offset, and stream interval.
